result.brief: 提出 NAVA-WAM，通过仅观测视频上的未来视频流匹配监督直接预训练动作策略，学习动作先验，再用联合视频-动作流匹配后训练，实现可扩展的世界动作模型。
result.reason: World action model pretraining action policy from observation-only videos via future-video flow matching; joint video-action flow matching with transition-structured attention. Robot control focus, but world-model representation contribution.
